editorial.blurb: Seni's Ethiopian Kitchen brings vibrant, generously portioned Ethiopian flavors to Taunton's street food scene with genuine warmth and care.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the wraps at East Street food market—reviewers rave about the huge portions of meat and say the value is so good they wonder how the kitchen stays in business.

topDishes.note: reviewers love the generous meat portions and perfect seasoning
fantastic flavors with impressive vegan selection rarely seen locally
